Rooting might help with this situation, haven't tried it though since I have some older xiaomi phones which are pretty difficult to root (already bricked one)

**[2024-10-30] heavykeys**
Step 1: Install ffmpeg (if it’s not already installed)
Open Terminal on your Mac.
Install Homebrew if you haven’t already. This is a package manager that makes it easy to install software on macOS. You can install it with:
bash
Copy code
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"
Once Homebrew is installed, you can install ffmpeg by typing:
bash
Copy code
brew install ffmpeg
Step 2: Check the Metadata on Your Video (Optional)
If you want to see what metadata is currently in the video file, you can use:

bash
Copy code
ffmpeg -i your_video.mp4
This will output details about the file, including any embedded metadata.

Step 3: Remove Metadata from the Video
To remove all metadata from a video, use the following command:

bash
Copy code
ffmpeg -i input_video.mp4 -map_metadata -1 -c copy output_video.mp4
-i input_video.mp4: Specifies the input file (replace input_video.mp4 with your actual file name).
-map_metadata -1: This flag tells ffmpeg to strip all metadata from the file.
-c copy: Ensures the video and audio streams are copied without re-encoding, which speeds up the process and maintains the original quality.
output_video.mp4: The name of the new file with metadata removed (you can choose a different name if you prefer).
Step 4: Verify the Metadata Has Been Removed
To check that metadata has been removed, you can run the same check as in Step 2 on your output_video.mp4 file.

This process should result in a clean file with no embedded metadata

parser.im and hiker api are just scrapers used to scrape and filter followers, scrape comments, etc. each of these has its own code they don't let you their code, but you can connect to it via api.

**[2025-02-23] curdoc**
API is an old-fashioned style, currently highly limited by IG. It's a good way to post stories in bulk, reply to DMs, and do the first account profiling. I would not recommend using that way to get viral, such as posting reels or doing actions like follow, like, and story likes - limitations are pretty hard.

Emulators are working fine, specifically if you use Nomixcloner, which can hide that you are using Emulators by faking device fingerprints and other important info.

Using phones (or boxes) is the best and safest way to do all actions: Follow, Unfollow, post reels, Post likes, Story views, etc. That's a long-term solution. Investment is one-time in hardware; you don't need to replace it too often.

**[2024-07-09] lonewolf024710**
This is not a standard action block. New feature IG introduced in late 2023 or early 2024, accounts owners can review followers who follow them. Somewhere its enabled by auto on all accounts above 1k followers and somewhere you can manually enable it from settings. I dont know if its auto enabled in some countries too. So these follows are placed in separated tab and if account owner dont review followers within 30 days Instagram will auto delete those requests. Its one of their new spam protections. If your accounts are not trustable and only IG knows which factors influence that (we can only make guessing) it is high chance you will get these popups when you follow accounts that have this extra check enabled.

**[2024-07-14] lonewolf024710**
Guys in my opinion you are not getting slaves bans because of proxies, its mostly because of your accounts, actions, how they were made etc. Accsmarket is worst place to buy accounts just as example. But truth is new accounts are very difficult to setup and get running actions even if they are aged and were doing nothing for 1-3 years. I had accs randomly banned that were warmed up and working ok for 1 year or longer with thousands of followings/followers I wanted to cry to lose such accounts but what can you do. Just delete suspended ones and move on work with ones that survive. The game is much harder now than it was before.. Even the most simple things like changing username, profile pic, Bio, deleting all posts > adding new ones can trigger blocks/flags or get acc suspended. Its least to do with your IP - proxy. Avoid using Api at all ( no shortcuts ) and sit down start manually setting up your slaves accounts adding content etc. I was doing this 2 years ago for hundreds of accounts and you can too. Yes it takes time, but for example I need avg 10-15 min to login, change profile pic, add 15-21 posts manually myself on a real phone. First login accs on your phones then upload content to the phone and take it in your hands and start working. After you setup accounts dont do any actions 2-3 days, or even longer if you are patient. I would disagree with Simon and say Dont change username immediately, also Dont add links in Bio immediately but after some time. However all these things can be a guessing, nobody for sure know what trigger blocks, suspension. Just good luck


**[2024-07-14] lonewolf024710**

If possible avoid using content that show faces, and if you have time you can restore such accounts when they are suspended, with little photoshop skills you can send to IG photo with random person holding paper with a code. Also if you must remove posts to add your new ones dont delete old posts but archive them. And prepare to be very patient and to lose more accounts until you create a batch that will work perfectly in long time.

**[2025-01-28] aldaravi**
If anyone has the problem that when downloading the Google Sheet document, where there are texts in English that use: ´ and when downloading to the PC in Excel it turns into strange symbols, it is because of the UTF-8 encoding. I leave you the steps to be able to obtain the document correctly and then upload it to Onimator:

Open Excel (without opening the CSV document yet).
Go to Data → Get External Data → From Text/CSV File.
Select the CSV file and click Import.
In the import window:
Select "Comma Delimited".
Under "File Source", choose UTF-8.
Click Upload.
Then save the document to CSV and you can upload it to Onimator.

✅ This will ensure that special characters are displayed correctly.

Hello @everyone,

Just a quick reminder, we don’t provide one-on-one coaching or step-by-step teaching. We simply can’t do that because we have many important tasks to handle daily. Our priority is answering critical client questions and issues here on Discord and Telegram, running tests, reporting issues, and managing other important stuff.

We already have detailed tutorials that guide you from A to Z on setting up, But you need to put in the effort to learn and manage your setup. Also, use the search button in this Discord chat; you’ll find a lot of helpful information already available.

If you are posting and your goal is to reach views

1. Dont use a VPN
2. Use a Mobile Proxy or SIM card 
3. The location of the Proxy/SIM doesn't have to be US. IG is choosing your audience based on your Reel interactions. If people from the US interact with your content, it will be shown to the US, and if Indians, then to India.
4. Dont use API for posting Reels (API works great for Story posting and profiling accounts to run M/S)

It's related to the keyboard. It happens when the bot tries to type but can't use the keyboard for some reason.

How to Fix It:
1. Open your phone Settings > Keyboard Settings.
2. Turn off both Gboard and FastInputME keyboards.
3. Turn them back on after a few seconds.
4. Restart your phone and try again.

Theres a couple ways you can do this. If you have a proxy linked to your device and you have it on rotate, then you can use the same 12-20 linkes accorss the 12-20 accounts. **[2025-05-01] toyboxigaccounts_16292**
I suggest you run 12 accounts (2 hours each clone). The software does allow you to run as many accounts as you want (as long as there is enough time for them in 24 hours). However, it may just be better to let 12 accounts do actions since you will most likly end up splitting the same number of actions 12 accounts do, across 24 accounts due to the 24 hour time limit. The reason why 12 accounts is better than running 8 is due to the fact that Instagram might soft block your account if you do to many actions. 12 accounts per device is a good number that will help keep the accounts safe, while allowing you to do a lot of actions within the 24 hour period.

**[2025-05-21] .criisteffi**
in future apk's insta can use sdk's that require play integrity checks which check apk package name,version and signing certificate hash. I'm not aware of appcloner adressing this.

Nomix has chameleon that takes care of that. 

I think right now older apk's still work on android 11 or lower, even though safetynet, the predecessor to play integrity, has been sunset and returns an error when called.  App cloner and nomix can spoof it. Spoofing safetynet while google sunsets Safetynet means that either Insta knows you are using a clone and doesn't care about it or more likely that there is no build in expiration date on the safetynet attestation on your apk and the app still runs.

Instagram can check with an SQL query which apps that have safetynet still shoot mobile api requests to their server and block each and every one of them. Alternativley they can cutoff requests based on apk version to their servers.

Then there is the whole issue about Device Integrity which is part of the play integrity check for the apk, but this is only an issue if you root.

TLDR: time is running out on solutions that don't have a fix for play integrity, hence nomix futureproof with the visibility we have today

**[2025-05-27] Deleted User**
To summarize the process, ThreatExchange fights duplicates by converting every image or video into a perceptual hash, a tiny numeric “fingerprint” that captures overall visual structure instead of exact pixels. For photos it uses PDQ, which runs a discrete-cosine transform on a normalized, grayscale copy of the picture, thresholds the low-frequency coefficients, then stores the resulting 256-bit binary pattern; two images are considered the same when the Hamming distance between their hashes falls below a chosen threshold. For video it offers TMK + PDQF and the lighter vPDQ: they generate PDQ-style hashes for individual frames, then feed those through a temporal-match kernel that summarises frame order and content into a fixed-length vector (≈256 KB). Hash vectors are compared with fast cosine or Hamming distance searches, making matches robust to compression, scaling, crops or brief edits. The repo’s Hasher-Matcher-Actioner service stores known hashes, scans incoming media in real time, and triggers whatever policy you define the moment a duplicate (or near-duplicate) score crosses your threshold.

How to copy settings at Bumble and Tinder bot.

Here is a simple explanation of how to copy the settings of the account to another one (it will copy all settings).

1. Open bot folder
2. Open the device folder
3. Open Bumble/Tinder folder
4. Open the account folder (this is where you have set up settings)
5. Copy files: Settings.db and Messages.db
6. Paste into newly added accounts

PRO TIP:

At sent_message.db you can check your chat history.

To open DB files, you will need to install SQL DB Reader Lite, and open database using SQL DB Reader

New IG Update

With the last update (13.7.0), we implemented OpenAI Assistants integration. 

Most of you probably already know how powerful they can be. We did it mainly for non-OF-related businesses and IG Growth agencies, but there can be many use cases.

First, you can "feed" an assistant with your product data and prompt it as a sales agent who can sell your products or "warm up" leads. 

It can be used for main business Instagram accounts or Slaves (you can assign one assistant per multiple slaves, and it will not interfere with conversations, maintaining the context of the current chat).

With today's update, we have improved it even more.

1. If you have Business clients who already have conversations at their DMs, we have added the option to ignore these chats so the bot can reply to messages only from the bot. To avoid replying to chats where your client chats manually.

2. Separated limits for the type of DMs you want to send. From now on, you can set up different daily limits for your slaves to send outreach DMs (cold DMs), while you can keep higher limits for replying using AI integration and/or OpenAI Assistants.

**[2025-12-21] curdoc**
🔥 **HUMAN BEHAVIOUR EMULATION IN ONIMATOR**

Real users:
- 👀 watch stories from their home feed
- 📜 scroll through posts
- ⏱ take short breaks between actions
- ❤️ sometimes like a story or a post and move on

Most classic bots ignore this and only spam follows/likes/DMs in a straight line.
👉 That kind of behaviour = **more blocks, more bans, shorter account lifespan**.

With **Human Behaviour Emulation** turned **ON** in Onimator, your device will automatically:
- 👁‍🗨 watch stories from your home feed
- 🌀 scroll your home feed posts
- ⏳ add small, natural delays between actions
- 💓 occasionally like a story
- 👍 occasionally like a post

This makes your activity look much closer to a normal user, which means:
- ✅ **longer account lifespan**
- ✅ **fewer temporary blocks**
- ✅ **lower chance of bans** (when combined with reasonable limits on other tasks)
────────────────────
🛠 **CURRENT RECOMMENDED SETTINGS**

For most accounts ,we currently suggest:

**Stories from home feed**
- 📺 Watch around **10–20 stories per operation**
**Home feed scrolling**
- 📜 Scroll around **25–50 posts per operation**

These values create enough “background activity” to look natural, without being too aggressive.
────────────────────
✅ **TL;DR**

Human Behaviour Emulation is not a magic shield, but it’s a **very important safety layer**.  
It helps your accounts look and act like real people, which significantly improves safety when you run your main **Follow / Like / DM** automations.

If you’re using Onimator and don’t have Human Behaviour enabled yet, this is a **great moment to turn it on** and apply the settings above.
@everyone

🚀 **Xmator just got a major performance update!**

This release focuses on **speed, reliability, and smoother automation** — especially during high server load.

✨ **New Features & Improvements**
• **Priority Worker Pool**
  Tweet + reply operations now run on a dedicated high-priority worker pool — eliminating timeout errors and failed posts during peak load.

• **Background Post Follow-Ups**
  Pin, like, and reply-after-post now run in the background.
  You’ll see instant tweet success instead of waiting 2+ minutes.

• **Profile Sync on Bulk Import**
  Bulk-imported accounts now automatically sync profile data (followers, following, tweets) after login.

• **Mass Session Refresh**
  New **“Refresh All Sessions”** button to re-validate all account sessions at once + shows the last refresh time per account.

• **DM Tool — Start All / Stop All**
  Quickly start or stop DM sending for **all accounts** with one click.

• **Clear Queue for Group**
  New option to clear the DM queue for **all accounts in a group** at once.

• **Auto-Send Scraped Users to DM**
  Automatically send scraped users to the DM tool for selected accounts — streamlined workflow, fewer steps.

⚡ **Bug Fixes**
• **Ghost Post Fix**
  Fixed an issue where tweets posted successfully but showed as **“Failed”** in the UI due to server timeouts.

• **Account Login Fix**
  Fixed session token extraction during login that could cause accounts to show as **“Active”** without a valid session.

• **Clear Proxy Error Fix**
  Clearing proxy errors now properly re-queues accounts for login validation instead of incorrectly marking them as active.

• **Unfollow Failure Handling**
  Accounts failing unfollow due to proxy issues are no longer incorrectly counted as unfollowed — retries now work correctly.

• **Proxy Edit Fix**
  Editing a proxy now applies the new format instead of continuing to use the old one.

• **Profile Editor Image Size Fix**
  Fixed error **413** in the profile editor caused by large image uploads — images are now resized before uploading.
